# SanskritMacros — EmEditor, MS Excel, MS Word Sanskrit macros & scripts

> Macro and script collection for Sanskrit text processing in EmEditor, Excel and Word (transliteration converters, tag extraction).

## Pages

- [SanskritMacros home](https://gasyoun.github.io/SanskritMacros/) — index into the macro library.
